scope: Public main revisions pinned once for the whole refresh, and the deployed GitHub Pages responses, except CultureMech, whose figure is read from its committed README on main because no page it reliably serves states the count; the vocabulary census, subsets and card stats were regenerated at the same pins. CLAW has a separate manifest-only admission pin dated October 1, 2026; the original ten Mech pins and their derived data remain unchanged. New project introductions are pinned separately in additions.json.

repositories.notes: 2,939 data/antibiotics records at the pin (2,669 ontology-grounded, 270 minted; 80 REVIEWED, 30 PROPOSED, 2,829 SEEDED), equal to the stat tile. The 95 commits since the previous audit add no records and change no record's curation status. In the records they adopt CRyPTIC Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex activity observations into 26 existing records (56 now carry an activity spectrum, up from 38) and add BioSample accessions to 431 existing activity observations; the rest add 33 record-review reports, attribution updates and tooling, mostly for sources still under evaluation (Stanford HIVDB, NCBI Pathogen Detection AST). The live index.html is byte-identical to pages/index.html at the pin.

The live index.html had moved past the pin when this audit was written; site_html_sha256 is the live copy and site_html_sha256_at_pin is pages/index.html at the pin. DUFMech is introduced separately on the website and is not declared in this CLAW snapshot. The ten-Mech census, card figures and statistics keep their September 28 pins.

The app/ landing tile still reads 10,657, a legacy figure that matches no data layer. The three commits since the previous pin track YAML review reports, removing them from .gitignore, and add review-skill text; no record, README or schema changed. The live README.md is byte-identical to README.md at the pin.

The live index.html is byte-identical to pages/index.html at the pin.
